test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 09 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Proportional taxes would help to reduce the autonomous expenditure multiplier because ______.

options.text: MPC does not have any role in it

solution:
The correct answer is __**taxes reduce the MPC.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Proportional taxes:-**

 
 
• A proportional tax is one where everyone pays the same percentage of their income in taxes. This means that as income increases, so does the amount of tax paid.
 
• It would help to reduce the autonomous expenditure multiplier because taxes reduce the MPC.
 
• The MPC, or marginal propensity to consume, is the fraction of additional income that a person or household spends. When taxes increase, disposable income decreases, which in turn reduces the MPC.
 
• By reducing the MPC, proportional taxes can help to stabilize the economy by dampening the effects of fluctuations in autonomous expenditure, such as changes in investment or government spending.
 
• Other types of taxes, such as regressive taxes (where lower-income people pay a higher percentage of their income in taxes) or progressive taxes (where higher-income people pay a higher percentage of their income in taxes), could have different effects on the MPC and the autonomous expenditure multiplier.
